scope: Combined browser tool tolerance, model-visible contracts, and shared image pipeline review

findings.before: A single width-derived scale shifted vertical clicks near the bottom of tall resized pages.
findings.after: Full-page coordinate actions use independent width/content_width and height/content_height ratios.
findings.regression: A 40x2 CSS-pixel button near y=9950 on a 1440x10000 page, clicked using the actual 285x1980 preview.

findings.before: Child process numeric exit code 1 leaked into the public tool error code on a CDP observation timeout.
findings.after: Observation timeouts map to PAGE_UNRESPONSIVE and other observation process failures to BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE. Numeric exit codes cannot bypass normal classification. No mutation retry added.

findings.before: The restart test reused a Crashed profile from an intentional owner-loss test and selected Default instead of its dedicated fixture.
findings.after: Explicitly select a disposable fixture profile, assert its normal close, and compare every restored URL across a quota reduction from 4 to 1. Existing profile exit_type is untouched.

findings.before: The Rust MCP end-to-end test still expected PNG after the intended WebP contract change.
findings.after: Assert image/webp; the full workspace suite passed.

findings.before: The file image regression used a browser fixture helper to hash a file in a custom Server workspace that intentionally has no Playwright.
findings.after: Compute SHA-256 through Python in the same workspace; retain the exact byte-integrity assertion and the desktop-disabled assertion.

findings.before: A single failed read of task status actively cancelled the original task. Server VNC wake regression returned cancelled, but existing logs do not prove its precise cause.
findings.after: Continue bounded status reads for the same task; retain explicit cancellation, authorization checks and original deadline. No action replay.
findings.regression: Pause the disposable helper for five seconds during an action and assert completion plus exactly one click.

findings.before: Profile readiness waited for health.page=true, a normal-state field intentionally removed from agent output. The page was already open.
findings.after: Wait for public page_id outside profile_picker; retain profile state, idle recovery, selected-profile and page-count assertions.

findings.before: Two workbench test calls retained wait.ms after the public API changed to seconds.
findings.after: Use secs=1 for a compositor settling step and secs=0 for the HUMAN_CONTROL refusal assertion; preserve UI, control and lifecycle assertions.

public_contract.started_at_policy: Actions, screenshot sequences, running or failed accepted tasks; omit for routine successful snapshot/read/list/single capture.
public_contract.duration_secs: All accepted browser tasks; monotonic elapsed seconds rounded to one decimal, fixed after completion.

validation: Complete shared functionality covered on both targets; Server evidence combines seven suites and UI/restart supplement using identical product sources and binaries.
